title: Fed Beige Book (pre-FOMC edition for the June 8-9 2027 meeting), 2:00 p.m. ET
source: EST: rule-derived from two federalreserve.gov primaries read by the fomc-minutes-2027-05-19 initial research on 2026-09-08, because the Board has posted no 2027 Beige Book schedule at all. THE RULE: the pre-FOMC Beige Book publishes at exactly D-14 from the decision day, reproduced 8 of 8 against the Board own 2026 schedule (monetarypolicy/publications/beige-book-default.htm) as recorded by the confirmed canonical beige-book-2026-11-25.json -- editions Jan 14, Mar 4, Apr 15, Jun 3, Jul 15, Sep 2, Oct 14, Nov 25 against 2026 decision days Jan 28, Mar 18, Apr 29, Jun 17, Jul 29, Sep 16, Oct 28, Dec 9, every pair exactly 14 days. THE MEETING: fomccalendars.htm re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, footer "Last Update: August 19, 2026") lists the 2027 June meeting as "June 8-9*"; decision day 2027-06-09 minus 14 days is Wednesday 2027-05-26, weekday verified. FILED ESTIMATE ON THREE COUNTS, none of which is doubt about the arithmetic: beige-book-default.htm was fetched today (HTTP 200, 86,202 bytes) and carries NO 2027 editions, federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2027-may.htm returned 404, and the same fomccalendars.htm states "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- so the underlying June meeting date is itself tentative until the 2027-04-27/28 meeting ratifies it. A discovering lane also may not self-confirm an event it found in-sweep. The promotion trigger is the Board posting its 2027 Beige Book schedule, or newsevents/2027-may.htm appearing. notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-minutes-2027-05-19 initial research (2026-09-08) because that event own proposal note claimed the April-meeting minutes are "the ONLY scheduled Fed communication" between the 2027-04-28 decision and the 2027-05-29 blackout. They are not: this Beige Book lands 2027-05-26, seven days after the minutes and three days before the blackout opens, which makes the minutes the FIRST of two scheduled Fed communications in that 21-day corridor rather than the only one. THIS CALENDAR TRACKS ONLY 2026 BEIGE BOOKS (2026-09-02, 2026-10-14, 2026-11-25, all canonical) and none beyond, so the gap is real rather than a duplicate. NOT PROPOSED, deliberately: the other seven 2027 editions (D-14 from January 26-27, March 16-17, April 27-28, July 27-28, September 14-15, October 26-27 and December 7-8) are volume, not discovery -- none is adjacent to the proposing event, and this lane files what its own corridor analysis surfaced rather than completing a calendar it did not research.
